description: A configured sheet wing rib with defined spar and lightening cuts; its aircraft attachment and load case are project design requirements.
releaseRequirements: Specify sheet material, grade, thickness, grain or laminate orientation and cutting process.
Verify spar slot fit with a coupon and define cutter corner treatment, tolerances, kerf and edge finish.
Size rib spacing, spars, skins, trailing edge strip and bonded or mechanical joints for the aircraft loads.
